newsitem.title: USA: Sun Co on list of air pollution violaters.
newsitem.headline: Sun Co on list of air pollution violaters.

text.p: Sun Refining and Marketing, a unit of Sun Co Inc., was named by the government on Friday as one of 16 companies added to a national list of institutions in significant violation of air quality control standards.

In press release late Friday, the Environmental Protection Agency said government officials will be working with Sun and the 15 other companies in Pennsylvania to bring them into compliance. The list is drawn up when a state calls in with
an update of companies in violation of air standards set out by the federal Clean Air Act.

Friday's list was drawn up in response to data supplied by the state of Pennsylvania. The other companies cited on list include National Fuel Gas Supply, RJM Manufacturing and Bethlehem Steel Corp, the release said.
The release added that the EPA and the Department of Environmental Protection "are committed to enforcing the Clean Air Act and ensuring that companies obey the law."
There are scores of companies nationwide that have already been identified by the EPA as contravening air quality regulations. Agency officials did not have the data immediately available.
